title: Overall impression after treatment (PGI-I)
description: A single-question measure of overall patient-perceived change after a treatment, procedure, or surgery. The FDA-endorsed responder definition: scores of 1 or 2 ("much better" or "very much better") indicate a treatment responder.

items.text: Compared with how you felt before your treatment, how would you describe your condition now?

interpretation_bands.label: mild_improvement
interpretation_bands.patient_label: Slight improvement — worth continuing to track.

interpretation_bands.label: worse
interpretation_bands.patient_label: Worse than before — worth a closer look at the plan.

thresholds.message: Treatment responder (PGI-I ≤2). Outcome recorded for the registry.
Patient reports being much worse or very much worse after treatment. Recommend prompt clinician outreach.

citation: Yalcin I, Bump RC. Validation of two global impression questionnaires for incontinence. Am J Obstet Gynecol 2003;189:98-101. PMID: 12861145
license_note: Free for clinical use. Widely used as a regulatory endpoint.
